text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One popular method is using SMART goals, which are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. This approach helps teams stay focused and track their progress. It is also important to define milestones, which are key points in the project timeline, and deliverables, the final products or results you must provide. Finally, you need stakeholder alignment. This means making sure everyone involved, from team members to clients, agrees on the goals and understands their role. When all these elements are in place, your project is much more likely to succeed.
